title: sarracenia alabamensis subsp. wherryi
intro: Sarracenia alabamensis subsp. wherryi, commonly known as the Wherry's trumpet pitcher plant, is a rare carnivorous plant species native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sarracenia alabamensis subsp. wherryi include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant have not been extensively studied, but it is believed to contain iridoids, sesquiterpenes, and other compounds with potential medicinal properties.
